articles.summary: AXT, Inc. (NasdaqGS: AXTI ), a leading manufacturer of compound semiconductor substrates, will announce its financial results for the third quarter 2026 in a press release immediately following the close of market on October 29, 2026. The company will also host a conference call to discuss these results on October 29, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. PT. The conference call can be accessed at (833) 461-5787 (passcode 457551713). The call will also be simulcast at www.axt.com . The webcast will be available at http://www.axt.com until October 29, 2027. Additional investor information can be accessed at http://www.axt.com . About AXT, Inc. AXT is a material science company that develops and manufactures high-performance compound and single element semiconductor substrate wafers comprising indium phosphide (InP), gallium arsenide (GaAs) and germanium (Ge).
